name: the-doorman
description: Convention-validation tasks targeting the-doorman member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY valid or invalid and nothing else for this commit message: 'fix stuff'.
Reply with ONLY valid or invalid and nothing else for this commit message: 'feat(cart): add quantity guard'.
Reply with ONLY valid or invalid and nothing else for this branch name: 'Fix_Login_Bug'.
tasks.expectedOutput: Invalid, branch names are lowercase hyphenated.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the missing item and nothing else for a PR with no linked issue.
Reply with ONLY merge or block and nothing else for a PR whose CI run is red.
tasks.expectedOutput: Block, never merge on red CI.
